It peaks on the modifier or first sub-token of the nature noun phrase and is silent on built places (city, museum, office, hospital), on plain animal names, and on the same words in non-ecological senses (power plant, desert the army, dry humor, dry paint). Separately, the first '.' token of any text (full stop, decimal point or abbreviation) fires at about 0.4 of max whatever the content, while later periods stay silent.
